messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large quadrupedal creature with the shaggy brown fur, head, body, legs and paws of a brown bear standing in right profile, with a glossy dark brown-black segmented beetle-like carapace covering its entire back from the neck to the rump and a single long curved glossy black beetle-like horn growing from the top of its forehead and arching backward.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "furry brown bear head with lighter tan muzzle, black nose and small dark eyes", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body"}, {"looks_like": "long glossy black curved horn with a small barb on the underside", "part": "horn", "where": "on top of the head between the ears arching backward over the neck"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry brown bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on the top sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "thick shaggy brown bear legs covered in long fur", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in back"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry bear paws with short dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "short furry brown stub", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark brown to black segmented dome-like beetle carapace", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the entire back from behind the head to the rump"}, {"looks_like": "row of brown strap-like plates with light oval spots and circular holes", "part": "plates", "where": "along the lower side edge of the shell above the furry flank"}, {"looks_like": "dense long shaggy brown fur", "part": "fur", "where": "covering the head, body and legs except the shell"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
